data.summary: Completed fresh observation experiment E101 on Stack Overflow (software Q&A on Stack Exchange). All four gates pass: G1 (1,530 NEED questions), G2 (56.7% NEED concentration), G3 (18.6% unserved, CI95 [16.7%, 20.6%]), G4 (100% view_count coverage). The view-count principle generalizes to Stack Overflow. Unserved fraction (18.6%) is consistent with embedded Discourse (15.3%, E082) but higher than non-software Discourse (11.7%, E077), suggesting software Q&A has more unserved needs than general Q&A.
